findings.reason: one verdict cannot cover both the contract and an operational measurement, and the script's baseline is exactly the artifact a later section would gate on.
findings.text: §7 combines the worker-contract change (with its three test cases) and a standing measurement script that records a baseline for a named window; the section's gate measures only the contract, so the script cannot be reviewed or closed on the same verdict

findings.reason: the only stated behaviour of a carried plan that a reader asked for is unmeasured, exactly the gap a done-when exists to close.

findings.reason: the deliverable's rule keys on the result's nature rather than the done-when's wording, which fixes the real gap regardless of which clause the diagnosis blames, so the mechanism and the sections are unchanged.

findings.reason: the numerator is small under any definition, so the conclusion that landed records rarely name their sprint holds and the design decision is unchanged.
